The problem

Your experience isn’t the problem. Your resume is.

Three things that quietly hold most resumes back.

  1. 01

    Built for looks, not for screening

    Two columns, icons and graphics can get scrambled when ATS software reads your resume.

    ✓ Clean single-column ATS format

  2. 02

    A summary that could be anyone

    “Hardworking and motivated” tells a recruiter nothing about you.

    ✓ A sharp summary built around your target role

  3. 03

    Duties, not results

    “Responsible for…” lists the job. Recruiters look for what you achieved.

    ✓ Achievement-led bullet points
